name: Supply Chain Risk Assessment
description: Assesses and tracks supply chain risk for tools, MCP servers, and third-party dependencies used by agents. Evaluates trust relationships, monitors dependency health, and identifies supply chain compromise indicators.
threat_addressed: AI agent supply chains — tool providers, MCP servers, model providers — introduce third-party risk. Compromised tools can exfiltrate data, inject malicious behavior, or provide a persistent foothold. Without supply chain assessment, organizations accept unknown third-party risk.
enforcement_mechanism: Tracks tool provenance, version history, and third-party trust relationships. Monitors for supply chain indicators including unexpected tool updates, new MCP server registrations, and dependency changes. Generates supply chain risk reports.

security_outcome.pass: Supply chain dependencies documented and risk assessed within acceptable tolerance.
security_outcome.fail: Supply chain risk not assessed or exceeds defined tolerance.

display_detail: Assesses supply chain risk for tools, MCP servers, and third-party dependencies.
remediation_hint_template: Supply chain risk assessment incomplete. Register and assess all tool dependencies used by this agent.
